note: Object x,y positions are randomized independently per sample within randomization_range_m, subject to pairwise non-overlap rejection sampling (see footprint_radius_m / clearance_margin_m). z is held fixed per-prop at its own resting height (resting_z_m) -- never at one shared table-surface value. Randomized layouts are NOT validated or claimed as physically reachable/solvable scene configurations: ADR-038 found that moving even a single prop can break the handoff skill at phase 3. This dataset trains a perception model (PoseNet) only; no manipulation skill is ever executed against any sampled layout in this script.
